## Summary

Defined agent-emitted enrichment properly in a note after being asked what the term meant, and sharpened it into a decision rule for item 5. The key finding is that the pattern is not new to this codebase but a generalisation of something already chosen: sofar_log_decision already accepts a guard argument, a machine-checkable glob list the AGENT writes and sofar merely matches, and core index-tier1 names the concept declared relevance in its own header comment. So the model supplies judgement while sofar supplies storage, matching and determinism. Extending it means new event types in packages/schema for relevance links, topic tags, supersession edges and summaries, emitted through tools agents already call. It spends no invariant because sofar still never calls a model, the fold stays a pure function of the event set so determinism and replay survive, and marginal inference cost is near zero since the agent already holds the record in context, which satisfies felt-cost D3 rather than superseding it. Four costs recorded honestly: it is non-retroactive so the existing 10,460 events stay bare, it is non-uniform across sessions and models, it depends on agent compliance which this repo already knows is imperfect, and most importantly it yields declared relevance and never discovered relevance. That last point converts the ruling from an implementation choice into a choice of goal: a richer index over connections someone thought to make takes this route and costs nothing, whereas surfacing connections nobody declared requires embeddings and an explicit supersession of SPEC Architectural invariants and felt-cost D3. Recorded the trap: adopting this route while intending the second goal will look like progress and then fail at exactly the query that motivated the feature.

## Next action

Rule item 5 by naming the GOAL first, not the implementation: if the goal is a faster and richer index over declared connections, take the agent-emitted enrichment route and no Decision is needed; if the goal is discovering connections nobody declared, log a Decision superseding SPEC Architectural invariants and felt-cost D3 before any work, since only embeddings answer that. Everything else on this initiative is already pointed at its own record.
